newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group rated buy.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said it has begun coverage of Apollo Group Inc, a provider of adult education courses, with a buy rating.
-- In a statement, the investment research firm said it believes "the stock is attractive as a premiere groth franchise in education."
-- Robertson, Stephens estimates the company can earn $0.58/shr in 1997 and $0.80/shr in 1998.
